questions.question: What age is the camp suitable for?
questions.answer: The camp is for children and young people aged 7-17. Activities are adapted for everyone - both for the little ones and for the older ones.

questions.question: Who is the camp not for?
questions.answer: The camp is not for PARENTS :). Prepare them well so they know what is expected of them and ask them to be responsible during the camp: respect all camp rules, meal and class times...

questions.question: Can a camper choose two or more workshops in the same week?
questions.answer: Choosing multiple workshops in the same week is not possible since all workshops take place at the same time. However, each following week you can choose a different workshop.

questions.question: Which program to choose depending on age?
questions.answer: 7 - 10 years: Oxford English Academy... 10 - 17 years: Any workshop... 12 - 17 years: Adventure English... 15 - 18 years: Junior Animator Academy.

questions.question: Can a child change programs in camp?
questions.answer: If it really doesn't suit them, the program can be changed during the first two days. Please send requests to office@euroclub.hr.

questions.question: Will my child learn English in camp?
questions.answer: In seven days children will START USING the language. Passive knowledge will become active in the company of teachers and international friends.

questions.question: Is attendance at classes mandatory?
questions.answer: YES. CLASSES ARE MANDATORY! Apart from being one of the camp's goals, we use class attendance to check children's presence.

questions.question: What is the reservation process?
questions.answer: 1. Fill out the form... 2. Administrator contacts you... 3. Payment instructions... 4. Letter with camp info... 5. Departure/arrival instructions.

questions.question: What in case of cancellation?
questions.answer: Travel insurance is available. Without insurance, refunds are: up to 60 days (85%), 59-21 days (50%), 20-8 days (30%), 7-0 days (0%).

questions.question: Is transportation included?
questions.answer: Transportation is not included. We organize transportation WITH ESCORT from larger cities for groups.

questions.question: What is the optimal length of stay?
questions.answer: One week for children up to 10 years who are not used to being without parents; two to three weeks for older children.

questions.question: Is meal attendance mandatory?
questions.answer: YES. Even if they don't want to eat, children are required to attend meals so leaders can monitor them.

questions.question: What is the accommodation like?
questions.answer: Participants are accommodated in pavilions in Luša settlement near Šibenik. Rooms have 3-4 beds, private toilet and shower.

questions.question: How is the camp functioning organized?
questions.answer: Rules must be respected. Nutrition is self-service. Mobile phones are prohibited in classes and during meals.

questions.question: How to contact leaders in camp?
questions.answer: You will get contact details available from 10:30-12:00 every day, other times ONLY FOR EMERGENCIES.

questions.question: Send an additional question
questions.answer: If you have additional questions, send them to office@euroclub.hr

cta.subtitle: My age is:

intro.desc1: Participants are accommodated in pavilions in the shade of century-old pine trees in Brodarica near Šibenik. It is the only resort of this type on the Adriatic that is exclusively in the service of children and young people.
intro.desc2: In each pavilion, one room at the entrance belongs to teachers/supervisors who take care of them and to whom they can turn for anything 24 hours a day.
intro.desc3: Rooms have three or four beds, their own toilet and shower. The settlement has its own beach and the entire area is surrounded by dense pine forest. Several beaches in the town are about ten minutes walk away.
intro.desc4: In addition to a restaurant for 200 children, the settlement has open and closed spaces for classes, a disco, an entertainment room, an outdoor cinema and an amphitheater for entertainment and competitions. The resort also has a pool adapted for all ages with sun loungers and straw umbrellas.

safety.title: #Safe
safety.desc1: The Euroclub settlement is fenced and reserved exclusively for children and their escorts, without the presence of other guests. There are no hotels or high-frequency tourist facilities nearby. The camp is under video surveillance.
safety.desc2: During their stay, all participants are insured, and their teachers and animators, night guards and beach guards take care of their safety 24 hours a day. First aid is in the camp, and the clinic on duty is 5 minutes by car from the settlement.

fun.title: #Fun
fun.desc1: In addition to the cleanest sea and beach with a marine fun park, at their disposal are a football, basketball, handball court, bocce court, volleyball or beach soccer court, basketball court, adventure polygon - shooting range with air rifle and bow and arrow, and a marine park with toys in the sea with pyramid, water trail, UFO seesaw and many others. Among other activities at sea, we highlight SUP boards, freediving equipment, water walking ball, water jumping platforms and many others. To offer even more fun content, in the very center of the resort there is also a pool with all accompanying facilities to make the stay even more interesting and unforgettable. In the outdoor amphitheater every evening we organize attractive night programs of games, dance, music, as well as numerous sports and creative competitions.
fun.desc2: We provide the possibility of choosing numerous excursions to make your summer the best yet. Among others, Rafting, Karting, Jet Ski, Laser Tag, Adrenaline park, Dalmaland, Krka NP, Kornati NP, Telaščica PP, Krapanj island, Zadar sightseeing and many other facilities stand out.

location.title: #Location
location.desc: Euroclub Summer Camp is located in Brodarica near Šibenik. The camp is located in a century-old pine forest with access to its own beach. We are located near all major attractions of this area, such as the cities of Split, Šibenik, Vodice and Zadar, Krka NP, Kornati NP and many other locations and facilities (30-60 minutes drive). We would also highlight Plitvice Lakes NP, Paklenica NP, Vrana Lake PP, Velebit PP, and among other nearby attractions we highlight the Falconry Center, Ethno Village Dalmati and the Šibenik Visitor Center in the St. Ante Channel.

hero.title: Daily Routine
hero.subtitle: Activity schedule throughout the day at our summer camp

intro.desc1: Although mornings are reserved for studying, students will also find an hour or two to participate in our baywatch games on the beach, or simply relax between their lessons.
intro.desc2: In the afternoon our animators organize a variety of fun activities, tournaments and competitions, culminating with the Eurogames sport events where students represent and compete for their team in various games.
intro.desc3: Every evening, with plenty of music and dance, we organize parties and spectacles in the disco or on the beach. Two lucky competitors will become king or queen, miss or mister of the camp. We have prepared night swimming, a beach picnic, a karaoke show, outdoor movie festival and much more.

program.title: About the Program
program.desc1: Oxford English Academy offers an intensive English language learning program for children and youth from 7 to 17 years old, for all levels of language knowledge.
program.desc2: The program consists of 20 school hours per week, with an emphasis on communication skills and language use. Classes are dynamic and interactive, with games, songs and group activities that encourage students to participate actively.
program.desc3: Teachers are native English speakers or qualified English language professors, and groups are formed according to age and prior knowledge. At the beginning of the program, testing is conducted which includes online and conversation tests.
program.desc4: The program uses original materials from well-known publishers that enable effective learning. Upon completion of the program, participants receive a Euroclub certificate for completing the academy.

about.title: About the Program
about.desc1: Our Sports Academy combines physical activity with English language learning in a dynamic and engaging environment. Students participate in various sports including football, basketball, volleyball, swimming, and beach activities while communicating exclusively in English.
about.desc2: The program emphasizes teamwork, fair play, and healthy competition while building vocabulary related to sports, fitness, and team dynamics. Professional sports instructors guide activities and ensure safety while creating fun challenges that encourage English communication.
about.desc3: Daily activities include skill-building exercises, team challenges, friendly tournaments, and outdoor adventures. Students learn sports terminology, strategic thinking, and leadership skills while staying physically active and improving their English fluency.

availability.title: Availability
availability.desc: Sports Academy is available in all summer terms for children and teens aged 7-17.

adventure.title: Never boring – always an adventure!
adventure.desc: Combine your program with the Adventure Package for rafting, go-karts, jet ski, scuba diving, and more exciting trips!

hero.title: Digital Academy
hero.subtitle: Workshop for screenwriters, actors, producers, directors...

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: Combining creativity and technology for youth – learn filmmaking, digital media, and storytelling through hands-on projects.

creativity.title: Create Your Own Films
creativity.desc: Create your own films, shoot reports and become a real digital storyteller through interactive workshops.

media.title: Digital Media
media.desc: Learn camera techniques, editing, and production using professional equipment and software.

tech.title: Technology & Equipment
tech.desc: Work with modern filming equipment, professional cameras, and industry-standard editing software.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.desc: Receive a Euroclub certificate upon completion of the Digital Academy program.

hero.title: Art & Glamour Academy
hero.subtitle: Design your creation, do your makeup, dance and walk the fashion runway!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: This workshop is for all those who enjoy glamour – fashion runways, shows, makeup, clothing design, dancing, singing... It's the perfect opportunity to combine everything related to fashion and the music industry.

makeup.title: Makeup & Styling
makeup.desc: Learn various types of makeup and hairstyles, creating a before and after portfolio.

dance.title: Dance & Performance
dance.desc: Practice dance routines, walking techniques, and stage presence for the final show.

fashion.title: Fashion Design
fashion.desc: Create sketches for your own creations using natural materials, fabrics, and creative techniques.

runway.title: Fashion Runway
runway.desc: Grand Fashion Show finale on the beach stage with exhibitions and dance performances.

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: This program is designed for ambitious teenagers who want to develop leadership skills and learn business fundamentals. Through interactive workshops, team projects, and real-world simulations, participants discover their leadership potential.

skills.title: Leadership Skills
skills.desc: Develop leadership skills through practical projects, learn how to motivate a team and become a visionary.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.desc: Work in teams on real projects, develop communication and presentation skills.

projects.title: Real Projects
projects.desc: Plan, organize and execute ideas from concept to completion.

future.title: Future Ready
future.desc: Learn entrepreneurship basics, financial literacy, and social responsibility.

hero.title: Teen Challenger Academy
hero.subtitle: Your challenge. Your adventure. Your summer!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: Teen Challenger Academy is a two-week camp full of adrenaline, action, and excitement, created for teenagers who want more than an ordinary summer. The program combines fun, team challenges, and exploring Dalmatia.

adrenaline.title: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline.desc: From sports tournaments to water sports like windsurfing, SUP, diving, and jet skiing.

challenges.title: Team Challenges
challenges.desc: Physical challenges, team competitions, and obstacles that test endurance and perseverance.

safety.title: Safe Adventure
safety.desc: All activities supervised by certified instructors ensuring maximum safety.

excitement.title: Non-Stop Excitement
excitement.desc: Every day brings something new – rafting, go-karts, Dalmaland, and island adventures.

hero.title: Junior Animator Program
hero.subtitle: Train to become a camp leader and inspire the next generation!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: The Junior Animator Program is designed for responsible teenagers who want to develop leadership skills and become camp animators. Participants learn to organize activities, work with children of different ages, and develop their communication and mentoring abilities.

children.title: Work with Children
children.desc: Learn child psychology and techniques for engaging children of different ages.

tourism.title: Tourism Skills
tourism.desc: Gain practical experience in tourism and hospitality management.

skills.title: Professional Skills
skills.desc: Develop communication, organization, and leadership abilities.

future.title: Future Career
future.desc: Receive official certification and potential employment opportunities at Euroclub.

hero.title: Croatian Language Camp
hero.subtitle: Discover the beauty of Croatian language in its homeland!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: Our Croatian Language Camp offers international students a unique opportunity to learn Croatian while immersed in authentic Croatian culture. Native instructors provide engaging lessons that combine language learning with cultural exploration.

hero.title: German Language Camp
hero.subtitle: Discover German language and culture on the Croatian coast!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: Our German Language Camp provides immersive learning where students explore the German language through interactive activities, cultural workshops, and authentic communication experiences.

hero.title: Italian Language Camp
hero.subtitle: Experience the passion of Italian language and culture by the sea!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: Our Italian Language Camp offers a vibrant immersion into Italian culture and language. Students learn through engaging activities that capture the spirit of Italy - from animated conversations and expressive gestures to traditional music and arts.

hero.title: French Language Camp
hero.subtitle: Immerse yourself in French language and culture by the Adriatic Sea!

about.title: About the Program
about.desc: Our French Language Camp offers an immersive experience where students learn French through interactive activities, games, and cultural exploration. Native French instructors create an authentic environment.
